title: Meta ordered to pay New Mexico $25 billion for deceiving users about privacy on Facebook - AP News
description: A judge has ordered Meta to pay New Mexico $25 billion for deceiving users about privacy on Facebook, marking the biggest fine ever against the tech giant. Judge Francis J. Mathew said in Wednesday's ruling that Facebook’s conduct was intentional and executiv…

title: ‘Error’ caused Toledo chemical leak, EPA says, triggering evacuations and fear of explosion - CNN
description: A hazardous chemical tank release in Toledo, Ohio, forced hundreds of residents to evacuate or shelter in place, and the mayor warned Wednesday that it could still be explosive. Follow for live updates.

title: Pope Leo requires no further treatment after lung surgery, doctors say - NBC News
description: Pope Leo XIV will not need further treatment following lung cancer surgery, his doctors said Wednesday.
